local_changes: Evaluation-only provider policy: all upstream provider factories, model catalogs, image-provider registrations, provider OAuth implementations, ambient credential discovery and remote catalog networking are removed; the offline generator emits empty chat, image and classifier catalogs without bundled model data. ModelRuntime registers only explicit application models.

check:sources typechecks implementation sources for the gateway-only vendor using the current upstream package graph. The original upstream check command remains unchanged; application behavior is verified by the root unit and SDK integration suites.

Responses function calls finalize after terminal response validation. Matching item id, call id and name recover delayed gateway arguments from authoritative terminal output; duplicate call identities, item.added/item.done identity changes and malformed JSON objects are rejected before toolcall_end or execution, while interleaved calls, reasoning, text, usage and completed item.done arguments are preserved.

Application SDK builds skip bundled model/MCP catalog asset download and fixture generation in copy-assets. Official compiled fallbacks remain; the evaluation adapter explicitly registers gateway models and Worker PI_OFFLINE disables runtime catalog refresh.

Responses preserve the terminal status and incomplete reason before strict function-argument decoding. Invalid completed arguments report the actual tool name and call/item identity so Runtime can provide bounded repair feedback; incomplete calls remain undispatched and authoritative JSON parsing/identity validation are unchanged.

Responses function calls finalize after terminal response validation. Matching item id, call id and name recover delayed gateway arguments from authoritative terminal output; duplicate call identities and malformed, empty, mismatched or unfinished calls cannot execute, while usage and completed item.done arguments are preserved.

All Responses providers reject EOF without response.completed or response.incomplete, including plain-text self-hosted streams; a completed output item alone cannot produce a successful assistant message. Actual Pi/Prime adapter regression tests distinguish terminal validation from missing usage.

deepseek.license: MIT; component-specific licenses retained in copied package directories
local_changes: Model catalog loads retain usable provider groups on partial failures and allow the next explicit load to retry; fully healthy catalogs remain cached and concurrent retries share one request. Regression tests cover partial failure and recovery.
ANSI basic blue uses its original static palette color so application brand accents do not recolor terminal content; the existing color mapping test is updated.

Chat transcript side padding exposes --dsh-chat-inline-padding while retaining upstream composer clearance by default. Eris uses 16px on viewports up to 480px without changing composer or desktop geometry.

Assistant responses expose an application-owned visuals slot at the canonical final answer, plus a keyed Markdown fence slot. Eris renders accepted chart receipts once before the final response, keeps charts at the tail when no final answer exists, ignores chart placeholders, and renders bounded plain-text flow steps. Ordinary code fences retain the upstream renderer, streaming parser and safety behavior.
Standalone Markdown images are centered within the message column; inline image buttons retain inline layout.

Markdown asterisk strong emphasis opens before punctuation after adjacent CJK text or before non-ASCII punctuation, and closes after punctuation before adjacent CJK text or after non-ASCII punctuation before adjacent Latin letters or digits. Pure ASCII boundaries keep CommonMark rules; single-asterisk emphasis, escapes, code and math remain unchanged. Regression tests cover quoted and bracketed prose, mixed-language labels and the Eris response across streaming, text fragments, settlement and history replay.

AssistantMarkdown renders consecutive provider text fragments as one Markdown document with a stable first-block key. Authored newlines and non-text boundaries remain intact; split emphasis, tables and links render correctly in both streaming and restored replies. Regression tests exercise the actual assistant component with the Eris fragment pattern.

Original attachment factories, gallery and lightbox are reused for source-reference inspection; ToolRow image cards also accept the upstream preview source type and show dimensions only for real attachments. Bytes are resolved by the application only on expansion; original attachment behavior tests and a preview regression are retained.

Web-only source composition: UI, Connection/Gateway, Session client, Markdown, store and required Cordis/Typert dependencies. A staged refresh replaces the selected source graph without retaining deleted files. Aliases and source exports are recorded in sources.json; ordinary builds do not use the adjacent repository, Desktop carriers, native addons or Windows packaging.

local.patch exports the original HTTP RPC handler, allows a server-supplied mux URL, defaults to light, adds attachment/fork/read-only-workspace composition flags, omits an unavailable command launcher and replaces coding placeholder/hero copy. RPC framing and fold algorithms are unchanged; CSS only removes the unused official running-whale animation rules.

Official logo/wordmark and running-whale artwork, exports, fallback renderers and tests are removed. Application composition omits the brand plugin, settings themes/model marketplace and coding plugins. Application-provided logo and Eris name occupy the brand slots, including a running-status icon slot; upstream isolated clock, text shimmer and accessibility behavior are retained. The hero headline is Eris in both locales and the empty preview badge is omitted. Theme boot injection is fixed light.
Server bundle substitutes the original llm package manifest version literal for createRequire relative lookup; no protocol version or algorithm change.

Settings reuse ui-settings-general with optional technical rows omitted and ui-theme with its appearance selector omitted. Web defaults show detailed work steps and support the upstream 10–22 px conversation font range. Running status copy is localized as analysis; matching upstream tests are updated. All settings CSS and interaction components remain upstream.

Gateway model selection reuses upstream fuzzy search, provider ordering, grouped menus, sticky headings, keyboard focus and ModelListEditor (selectionOnly skips manual model editing). Original token/session metric projections and ToolCallRecovery are reused. Original transport, conversation, Markdown, model selection, menu, queue, running-status, tool-row and metric projection tests with their test-support dependencies and benchmark fixtures/budgets are retained. Agent adapters supply local Pi/session persistence and the installed Chrome binary.
Assistant reply HTTP(S) links render as plain source labels in streaming and restored Markdown, while tool evidence links, local file navigation, images and original stored content remain intact.

Trajectory Schema details show the complete recorded tool description and uncollapsed parameter JSON with an exact full-definition copy action; the overview keeps its compact tree. Eris records request/header tool catalogs for new calls. No historical schema is fabricated.

AssistantMarkdown suppresses finalized wrappers containing only blank reasoning and tool calls, preserving stable block keys and raw replay metadata. Upstream reasoning body filtering, text selections and process visibility remain authoritative.

The composer exposes a prediction slot inside its draft surface, borrowing the Lexical editor and disabled state. Eris owns prediction requests, ghost text and Tab/Escape handling; upstream command-menu priority, draft submission and native Shift+Tab navigation remain authoritative.

Eris reasoning selection uses a 304px native slider panel with a centered heading, full 26px pill track, 36px round thumb and per-model advertised levels. Ordinary levels use vermilion; only the highest uses a deep-red-to-warm-gold particle fill. Successful selections remain visible while the durable stream catches up; delayed acknowledgements cannot overwrite selections already advanced by that stream, including changes back to the initial value. Subsequent selection updates and reconnect remain authoritative. Drag interruption discards previews; save failure restores the saved value and keyboard focus. Tests cover delayed projections and acknowledgements, pointer release/cancellation, save/reset, pending lock and focus; reduced-motion and grouped model search remain supported.

Vendoring resolves source exports through their declared type entry and derives test roots from the executed upstream-test configuration. It replaces the selected source graph atomically and preserves this local-change ledger instead of maintaining a duplicate list.

Upstream npm dependency patches for the selected source graph are retained separately and applied idempotently to exact package versions during bootstrap, builds and upstream tests. The official Lexical caret-viewport fix is included in both development and production module formats.

Browser network hints no longer gate connection attempts or tear down reachable generations. Transport readiness/failure remains authoritative with bounded exponential retries; online events only accelerate disconnected recovery. Connection lifecycle and plugin tests run in the upstream suite, and browser smoke covers initial load and history reload while navigator.onLine stays false.
